result.justification: The research objective is clearly stated as predicting T-cell epitopes from Influenza A virus peptides. The methodology is well-defined, detailing the dataset, model architecture, and analytical techniques.

objective_evidence.quote: a transformer-based viroinformatics framework is proposed for the prediction of TCEs from Influenza A virus peptide sequences

method_evidence.quote: Model performance is evaluated using a comprehensive set of binary classification metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall (sensitivity), specificity, F1-score, area under the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve
